title: The Fractal Playbook — the Body's memory of obedience
body: The Body's shared memory of faithful obedience to the Head (Jesus Christ, the Word). Head = authority; Body = people acting in obedience; Playbook = the testimony of what was done, what happened, what was corrected. It is NOT Scripture — it cannot create doctrine or bind conscience. One pattern, repeated faithfully at every scale.
subject: the fractal playbook

connections.evidence: the Body's obedience to the Head — rooted in the Word

author: Matt Harris (Fractal Playbook)

title: The Atomic Unit — a Playbook Entry
body: Each entry is a single fractal unit: (1) Confession — 'I may be wrong…'; (2) Anchors — the Scripture refs used; (3) Action — OPEN / BUILD / RESERVE / PRUNE / HOLD; (4) Outcome — fruit / mixed / failed; (5) Witness — at least two affirmations to confirm; (6) Wait — a mandatory time gate; (7) Status — QUARANTINE → CONFIRMED (or REJECTED).
subject: the playbook entry

connections.evidence: a piece of the Fractal Playbook framework

author: Matt Harris (Fractal Playbook)

title: Four Gates — RED (aligned with Christ)
body: The first gate of confirmation: is it aligned with Christ? Reject if not. The Words in Red govern.
subject: the RED gate

connections.evidence: a piece of the Fractal Playbook framework

author: Matt Harris (Fractal Playbook)

title: Four Gates — FLOOR (holds the moral/stability floor)
body: The second gate: does it break stability or moral floors? Reject if broken.
subject: the FLOOR gate

connections.evidence: a piece of the Fractal Playbook framework

author: Matt Harris (Fractal Playbook)

title: Four Gates — BROTHERS (witnesses affirm)
body: The third gate: do the witnesses affirm? Quarantine until at least two are met (Matthew 18:16).
subject: the BROTHERS gate

connections.evidence: a piece of the Fractal Playbook framework

author: Matt Harris (Fractal Playbook)

title: Four Gates — GOD (the wait completes)
body: The fourth gate: has the wait period completed? Quarantine until the time gate is met. God confirms in time.
subject: the GOD gate

connections.evidence: a piece of the Fractal Playbook framework

author: Matt Harris (Fractal Playbook)

title: Pruning — entries are not permanent truth
body: Entries may be corrected, superseded, pruned, or marked 'failed'. Failure is not hidden; it is used to refine faithfulness (John 15:2 — every branch that bears fruit He prunes).
subject: pruning

connections.evidence: a piece of the Fractal Playbook framework

author: Matt Harris (Fractal Playbook)

title: Universality — one pattern at every scale
body: Because the structure is identical at every scale, the Playbook is portable: personal discipleship, family governance, church operations, economic development, engineering decisions. One pattern. Repeated faithfully.
subject: universality
